title: Feedback on My ASMR Game
author: Mysterious-Return458
selftext:
Game Title: Praxis

Playable Link:

[https://praxis-asmr.base44.app/](https://praxis-asmr.base44.app/)

It's an ASMR (sensory-pleasure) type of game meant to be played with the sound ON.

It can be played on computer or phone, phone is better due to touch screen.

It's just supposed to be a relaxing play experience, playing with shapes and unlocking things, nothing too crazy. There are some secret levels to find/unlock.

Thanks for any feedback, and yes, I created it with the help of AI. I wanted to see the capabilities of AI in developing a simple game and see what the limitations were. I began with the basic concept and kept challenging the system to make upgrades of various complexities, it handled most requests quite well and I am happy with the result in terms of what I envisioned, though the final execution is still what I would consider too rough for any kind of commercial application, or widespread use.
